Start with 25 starter Pavo AI credits and no card; top up once, from $15, when a project needs volume. Credits never expire, so the balance you buy this quarter still ships next quarter.

en.lp.uc.c1d: Script a scene in Pavo AI, keep your cast consistent.
en.lp.uc.c1x: Write the scene in the Pavo AI director, storyboard each shot, then generate with Kling 3.0 for long takes. Lock your cast with Pavo Timeline and cut the takes together in the editor — a finished three-minute short in about half an hour.
en.lp.uc.c2d: Image to video on Pavo AI: one photo in, a studio-grade spin out.
en.lp.uc.c2x: Drop one packshot into the Pavo AI Ad Studio and Veo 3.1 renders a studio-grade turntable in about two minutes. Pick your angle presets, generate three takes, then export a vertical and a wide cut for the product page.
en.lp.uc.c3d: Creator-style Pavo AI clips that actually convert.
en.lp.uc.c3x: Upload the product, pick a creator look, and Veo 3.1 shoots a handheld, talking-to-camera hook with synced audio in under two minutes. Batch four variations in Pavo AI, keep the one that holds attention, and ship it.
en.lp.uc.c4d: Beat-synced cuts made with Pavo AI, any aesthetic.
en.lp.uc.c4x: Generate the track in the Music Studio first, then cut every clip to its beats. Run one text to video prompt per lyric line, let the Pavo AI editor snap cuts to the waveform, and upscale the final cut to 4K in an evening.
en.lp.uc.c5d: Your stories in authentic anime styles.
en.lp.uc.c5x: Board your scenes in the Director, keep characters on-model with reference locking, and generate with Kling 3.0 or Wan for authentic linework. Most Pavo AI anime shots land in ninety seconds; a twelve-shot segment takes an afternoon.
en.lp.uc.c6d: Vertical, punchy, ready to post from Pavo AI.
en.lp.uc.c6x: Set the 9:16 preset, batch six hooks with Veo 3.1 Fast, and add auto subtitles in the Pavo AI editor before export. Ten minutes from blank prompt to a week of vertical posts, with no watermark on anything you publish.
en.lp.uc.c7d: Any script, any language, any face.
en.lp.uc.c7x: Upload one portrait, paste the script, and Avatar Talk renders a talking avatar with natural lip-sync in about three minutes. Clone your own voice or pick from forty others, then dub the same Pavo AI clip into thirty languages.
en.lp.uc.c8d: Epic opens for games and launches, made with Pavo AI.
en.lp.uc.c8x: Storyboard the beats in the Director, generate each shot with Veo 3.1 for realism or Sora 2 for range, then score it in the Music Studio and grade the cut in the Pavo AI editor. A sixty-second trailer takes about half a day end to end.

zh.lp.uc.c4x: 先在音乐工作室生成曲目,再让每个镜头卡在节拍上。每句歌词跑一条文生视频提示词,让 Pavo AI 剪辑器按波形对齐剪辑,最后升到 4K——一个晚上出一支完整 MV。
zh.lp.uc.c5d: 用地道动漫风讲你的故事。
zh.lp.uc.c5x: 在导演室画好分镜,用参考锁定让角色不变形,选 Kling 3.0 或 Wan 生成纯正赛璐璐线条。Pavo AI 动漫镜头大多 90 秒出片,十二个镜头的片段一个下午完成。
zh.lp.uc.c6d: 竖版、紧凑,直接从 Pavo AI 发布。
zh.lp.uc.c6x: 设好 9:16 竖版预设,用 Veo 3.1 Fast 批量出六个开头,导出前在 Pavo AI 剪辑器加自动字幕。从空白提示词到一周的竖版素材只要十分钟,全部无水印。
zh.lp.uc.c7d: 任意台词、任意语言、任意形象。
zh.lp.uc.c7x: 上传一张人像、贴上脚本,Avatar Talk 大约三分钟渲染出自然口型的数字人口播。可以克隆自己的声音或从四十种音色里挑,再把同一条 Pavo AI 素材配音成三十种语言。
zh.lp.uc.c8d: 给游戏和发布会一个史诗级开场,用 Pavo AI 做出。
zh.lp.uc.c8x: 在导演室排好节奏点,写实镜头用 Veo 3.1、风格化镜头用 Sora 2,再到音乐工作室配乐、Pavo AI 剪辑器调色。一支六十秒预告片端到端大约半天。
